bibl.title: A Xoite Stela of Ptolemy VIII Euergetes II with Cleopatra II and Cleopatra III (British Museum EA 612).
bibl.seg: Giuseppina Lenzo, A Xoite Stela of Ptolemy VIII Euergetes II with Cleopatra II and Cleopatra III (British Museum EA 612).
bibl.note: General presentation of the stela [Brit. Mus. inv. EA 616: limestone stela from Xois]. - Texts of the stela. - Commentary. - Historical background and dating of the stela. - A comparison between the relief of the stela and temple scenes. - Comparison between the Xoite stela and other stelae of the reign of Ptolemy VIII Euergetes II (145-116 BC). - Conclusion [either between 141/140-132 or 124-116 BC].
